                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is: Sincere.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The word \"Fulsome\" means excessive, overdone, or insincere in praise or flattery. (अत्यधिक, चापलूसी पूर्ण)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Example: The speech was so fulsome that it felt insincere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \"Sincere\" refers to being genuine, honest, and free from deceit or pretense. (ईमानदार, सच्चा)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Example: Her sincere apology was appreciated by everyone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Hence, we can infer that the antonym of \"Fulsome\" is \"S", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Vocabulary"], "concept": "Antonym", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6919d3a33f261c5e812e7503", "qs_no": 5, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Spot the correct spelling of body-position sense.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Proprioseption"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Propriocaption"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Proprioception"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Propriception"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The misspelled word is 'Proprioseption', 'Propriocaption', or 'Propriception'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The correct spelling would be 'Proprioception'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word 'Proprioception' is a noun which refers to the sense or perception of the position and movement of the body. (शरीर की स्थिति और गति का अनुभव)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For Example - 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Proprioception helps individuals maintain balance and coordinate their movements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is 'Proprioception'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n1be:Tc51,\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is: Paradox.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word "Paradox" refers to a statement that appears self-contradictory or illogical but may hold some truth upon deeper examination. (विरोधाभास)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: "Less is more" is a paradox because reducing something can actually enhance its impact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Paradox" emphasizes the concept of something seemingly contradictory yet meaningful when analyzed deeply. (विरोधाभास)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The idea that "ignorance is bliss" is a paradox—it suggests that not knowing can sometimes bring happiness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hence, the correct answer is: Paradox.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is: Paradox.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Axiom (स्वयंसिद्ध): A statement or proposition regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The axiom "the shortest distance between two points is a straight line" is fundamental in geometry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Maxim (सूक्ति): A short, pithy statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: "Actions speak louder than words" is a popular maxim.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Irony (विडंबना): The expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite, typically for humorous or emphatic effect.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: It was ironic that the fire station burned down.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n1c1:Tcd3,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Scarcely had the satellite deployed ____ it transmitted its first data packet.
